summary: Full end-to-end verification of the new FIFO debt payment feature (customers + suppliers). Backend: 22/22 new tests in test_fifo_debt_payment.py PASSED covering FIFO allocation, per-invoice allocations[], partial vs full payment, overpayment 400 guard, customer.status → 'paid', supplier_ledger kind='pharmacy_payment', /unpaid-invoices FIFO ordering, enriched supplier account (paper_orders, paid_amount, payment_status). Regression: 55/55 (test_paper_orders 20/20, test_fifo_inventory 10/10, test_returns_flow 25/25). Frontend web preview: /customers/[id] loads with 'تسديد دين' button + FIFO hint + all testIDs (pay-amount, btn-full-amount, btn-receive, pay-notes) + shows جزئي badges on sales; /accounting/supplier-accounts/[supplierId] loads with 4 balance cards, تسديد دين box, expandable 35 unpaid invoices, payment history with allocations, returns section — all testIDs (pay-amount, btn-full-amount, btn-pay-supplier, btn-toggle-invoices) found. No red-screen errors, no runtime crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: accounting.py L608-703 — Customer FIFO payment loop: sales sorted by created_at ASC, take = min(amount_left, sale_outstanding), fully_paid boolean, per-invoice allocation dict, defensive fallback for legacy data drift. Correct.

accounting.py L842-978 — Supplier FIFO payment merges marketplace + paper orders into a single FIFO stream sorted by created_at ASC. Marketplace uses paid_amount; paper orders push a sub_payment record and update amount_paid/remaining/payment_status. Master ledger entry with kind='pharmacy_payment' + allocations[] + recorded_by. Clean, matches customer pattern.

accounting.py L184-215 — _read_supplier_account outstanding formula = (marketplace + paper debit) − invoices_paid − credit_applied. Backwards-compatible: legacy docs without paid_amount count as 0. Correct.

accounting.py L738-790 — GET supplier-accounts/{sid} enriches each order with paid_amount + outstanding + payment_status (paid/partial/unpaid) and adds paper_orders[]. This gives the UI everything it needs for status badges without extra fetches.
accounting.py L620 — Zero-debt guard raises 400 'لا يوجد دين متبقٍ على هذا الزبون'. Verified.
accounting.py L621 — Overpayment guard uses 0.001 tolerance. Verified.
accounting.py L886 — Supplier overpayment guard uses 0.01 tolerance. Verified.
customers/[id].tsx L106-119 — Full testID coverage (pay-amount, btn-full-amount, pay-notes, btn-receive). Alert shows FIFO breakdown per allocation. Correct.

supplier-accounts/[supplierId].tsx L115-152 — Expandable unpaid invoices list with FIFO indices, testID on toggle + pay button + input, dual paper/marketplace invoice_type icons in allocations. Well-designed.

Both frontend files use react-native-safe-area-context (correct in Expo SDK 54), StyleSheet.create, all text wrapped in <Text>, no deprecated packages. No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage.
No MongoDB _id leaking in any endpoint tested. All responses use projection {_id: 0}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both /customers/[id] and /accounting/supplier-accounts/[supplierId] load and render with all testIDs on mobile viewport)
